# A transaction claiming a type GnuCash does not have.
#
# GnuCash knows three: `I` (an invoice or bill posting), `P` (a payment) and
# `L` (a link). Anything else written here would land in the engine's own
# type field and export straight back out, so a typo would become permanent
# book state rather than staying inert.
#
# What this fixture produces: the import is refused, naming the type.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_txn_type_restore.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Misc
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-01 * "Typed with a letter GnuCash does not know"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	txn_type: Z
	Expenses:Misc 10.00 CAD
	Assets:Bank -10.00 CAD
